Project.Name: SEATS project plan (Milestone 2)
Project.Title: Seating & Event Availability Tracking System (SEATS) for La Loy Restaurant
Project.Author: SE69 Group 1

Task.Name: 1.1 Project plans and baselines
Task.Notes: Produce the business case, the project charter, the organization, the Software Development Plan and the iteration plans I1 and I2. Output: Business Case, charter, organization chart, SDP (draft), iteration plans

Task.Name: 1.2 Risk List and Development Case
Task.Notes: Write the initial Risk List (RISK-01 to RISK-14) and the Development Case that tailors RUP for the project. Output: Development Case v1, Risk List

Task.Name: 1.3 Iteration assessments and change control, Elaboration
Task.Notes: Run the weekly status assessments, the E1 and E2 iteration assessments and the Change Control Board. Output: Status assessments, iteration assessments, change-request decisions

Task.Name: 1.4 Iteration assessments and change control, Release 1.0 Construction
Task.Notes: Run the weekly status assessments, the C1 and C2 iteration assessments and the Change Control Board. Output: Status assessments, iteration assessments, change-request decisions, Risk List updates

Task.Name: 1.5 Iteration assessments and change control, Release 1.0 Transition
Task.Notes: Run the weekly status assessments, the T1 assessment and the Change Control Board. Output: Status assessments, go-live record

Task.Name: 1.6 Iteration assessments and change control, Release 2.0
Task.Notes: Run the weekly status assessments, the C3 and T2 iteration assessments and the Change Control Board. Output: Status assessments, iteration assessments, change-request decisions

Task.Name: 1.7 Iteration assessments and change control, Release 2.1
Task.Notes: Run the status assessments, the C4 and T3 iteration assessments and the Change Control Board. Output: Status assessments, iteration assessments, change-request decisions

Task.Name: 1.8 Pilot KPI reports and reviews
Task.Notes: Collect the pilot KPIs of every concert night (booking time, double bookings, no-shows, check-in time, operating cost) and review them monthly with the Owner. Output: Monthly pilot KPI reports, waiting list of restaurants

Task.Name: 1.9 Pilot review, expansion decision and close-out
Task.Notes: Review the pilot year against the success criteria of the charter, prepare the expansion decision, record lessons learned and obtain sign-off. Output: Pilot review, expansion decision record, hand-over record, lessons learned, sign-off

Task.Name: 2.1 Stakeholder requests and problem analysis
Task.Notes: Interview the Owner and the Manager, observe concert nights, record the stakeholder requests, the problems and their root causes (5 Whys). Output: Stakeholder Requests, problem and root-cause tables (workshop of RISK-01)

Task.Name: 2.2 Vision and Glossary
Task.Notes: Write the Vision (problem statement, stakeholders, features F1 to F37 with value, cost and priority) and the Glossary. Output: Vision v1, Glossary

Task.Name: 2.3 Use-case model and release plan
Task.Notes: Outline the use-case model and assign the features to Release 1.0, Release 2.0 and Future. Output: Use-Case Model (outline), release plan

Task.Name: 2.4 Review records and LCO package
Task.Notes: Review the Inception artifacts against the RUP checkpoints, record the Review Records and assemble the LCO review. Output: Review Records, LCO decision

Task.Name: 3.1 Use-case specifications
Task.Notes: Specify the two main use cases, Reserve a concert table and Check in with e-ticket, with the Manager and the Front Staff. Output: Use-case specifications

Task.Name: 3.2 Software Requirements Specification and Supplementary Specification
Task.Notes: Write the SRS and the Supplementary Specification with the quality targets of Table 2.19 of Milestone 1. Output: SRS, Supplementary Specification

Task.Name: 3.3 Analysis model and Software Architecture Document
Task.Notes: Produce the analysis model and the Software Architecture Document (LIFF front end, back office, application server, central database, LINE and gateway integration). Output: Analysis Model, SAD

Task.Name: 3.4 User-interface prototype
Task.Notes: Prototype the customer and back-office screens and have the Manager, the Front Staff and sample customers try them. Output: UI prototype, trial records

Task.Name: 3.5 Payment gateway and LINE sandbox
Task.Notes: Open the gateway sandbox and the LINE Developers channel, verify the merchant onboarding and the LIFF and Messaging API settings (RISK-03, external dependency). Output: Sandbox accounts, onboarding checks, feasibility record

Task.Name: 3.6 Test plan and test cases
Task.Notes: Write the test plan and the test cases of the two main use cases, including the load-test design for 5 transactions a second (RISK-05). Output: Test plan, test cases, load-test design

Task.Name: 3.7 Requirements reviews, SRS baseline and LCA package
Task.Notes: Review the SRS, the SAD, the prototype and the test plan against the checkpoints, baseline the SRS and assemble the LCA review. Output: Review Records, SRS baseline, LCA decision

Task.Name: 3.8 Scope baseline, estimates, schedule and cost baseline
Task.Notes: Produce the scope statement, the WBS and dictionary, the effort, resource and cost estimates, the schedule and cost baseline (this document) and the Construction plan. Output: Scope statement, WBS, estimates, schedule and cost baseline, Construction plan

Task.Name: 4.1 Concert rounds, zones and packages
Task.Notes: Design, implement and unit-test the management of concert rounds, zones, table types, packages and prices. Output: Back-office round and layout functions, unit tests

Task.Name: 4.2 Table map, selection and hold
Task.Notes: Implement the round list, the real-time table map, the table selection with the 15-minute hold and the automatic hold release. Output: Customer table map and hold, first-lock-wins locking

Task.Name: 4.3 Gateway payment and callback
Task.Notes: Integrate the hosted checkout, the booking terms, the payment webhook and the automatic confirmation of the booking. Output: Payment flow with automatic confirmation

Task.Name: 4.4 LINE sign-in, staff accounts and role access
Task.Notes: Implement LINE Login, the back-office accounts and the role-based access of Manager, Front Staff and Owner. Output: Sign-in and staff accounts

Task.Name: 4.5 C1 integration and iteration test
Task.Notes: Integrate the C1 increment, run the iteration tests and the C1 assessment. Output: Tested C1 increment, iteration assessment

Task.Name: 4.6 QR e-ticket and transactional messages
Task.Notes: Implement the QR e-ticket, the customer's booking list and the transactional LINE messages. Output: E-ticket and messages

Task.Name: 4.7 Door check-in and name lookup
Task.Notes: Implement the QR scan, the ticket details, the check-in, the invalid-ticket escalation, the no-show release and the name lookup. Output: Front Staff check-in functions

Task.Name: 4.8 Live booking view and exception handling
Task.Notes: Implement the live booking view, the ticket escalation, the manual overrides and the degraded-mode switch. Output: Manager's live view and exception functions

Task.Name: 4.9 Audit trail, backup, consent and push budget
Task.Notes: Implement the audit trail, the daily backup with Excel export, the consent and profile access and the push-message budget. Output: System functions of Release 1.0

Task.Name: 4.10 Load test, system test and IOC package
Task.Notes: Run the load test (5 transactions a second at booking-open time), the system test of Release 1.0 and assemble the IOC review. Output: Load-test and system-test records, IOC decision

Task.Name: 5.1 Acceptance tests of Release 1.0
Task.Notes: Run the acceptance tests of the two main use cases with the Manager and the Front Staff. Output: Acceptance records

Task.Name: 5.2 Training and user guide
Task.Notes: Train the Manager and the Front Staff and hand over the user guide. Output: Training records, user guide

Task.Name: 5.3 Production set-up and data migration
Task.Notes: Set up the production hosting, the domain and the gateway merchant account of La Loy, and migrate the current bookings. Output: Production system, migrated data

Task.Name: 5.4 Pilot concert nights and go-live of Release 1.0
Task.Notes: Support the first concert nights on site, fix the defects found and declare Release 1.0 in operation. Output: Go-live record, Release 1.0 in operation

Task.Name: 6.1 Scheduled reminders
Task.Notes: Implement the reminder scheduling and the scheduled LINE reminders within the push-message budget. Output: Reminder functions

Task.Name: 6.2 Grace extension and waitlist
Task.Notes: Implement the grace extension, the waitlist and the waitlist offer (rules decided by the Owner, RISK-08). Output: Grace and waitlist functions

Task.Name: 6.3 Booking transfer
Task.Notes: Implement the official transfer of a confirmed booking to another LINE account. Output: Transfer function

Task.Name: 6.4 Reports and Excel export
Task.Notes: Implement the booking, revenue, artist-popularity and customer-history reports with export to Excel. Output: Reports

Task.Name: 6.5 C3 integration and system test
Task.Notes: Integrate Release 2.0, run the regression and system tests and the C3 assessment. Output: Tested Release 2.0, iteration assessment

Task.Name: 6.6 Acceptance tests and training on Release 2.0
Task.Notes: Run the acceptance tests of the new features with the Manager and train the staff on them. Output: Acceptance and training records

Task.Name: 6.7 Release 2.0 deployment and first concert nights
Task.Notes: Deploy Release 2.0, support the first concert nights and declare Release 2.0 in operation. Output: Go-live record, Release 2.0 in operation, pilot year begins

Task.Name: 7.1 Concert-night support and maintenance
Task.Notes: Support the pilot restaurant on concert nights (on-call engineer) and maintain the system: 8 hours a month, costed as operating expenditure of Year 1 in Milestone 1 (Table 3.6), outside the 2,632 development hours. Output: Support log, maintenance releases

Task.Name: 8.1 Multi-tenant data model and tenant isolation
Task.Notes: Design and implement the multi-tenant data model, the tenant isolation and the migration path of La Loy's data. Output: Multi-tenant core

Task.Name: 8.2 Plans, limits and tier enforcement
Task.Notes: Implement the Free, Standard and Premium plans, their limits and the automatic enforcement of the limits. Output: Plan and limit functions

Task.Name: 8.3 Subscription billing and company set-up
Task.Notes: Implement the subscription billing and the setup-fee invoicing; register the company and publish the terms of service, privacy policy and data-processing agreement. Output: Billing functions, company registration, legal documents

Task.Name: 8.4 Self-service onboarding and service administration
Task.Notes: Implement the self-service onboarding of a restaurant (zone map, packages, gateway and LINE set-up) and the service administration console. Output: Onboarding and administration functions

Task.Name: 8.5 Security, load and integration test of Release 2.1
Task.Notes: Run the multi-tenant security test, the load test and the system test of Release 2.1 and the C4 assessment. Output: Test records, iteration assessment

Task.Name: 8.6 Migration of La Loy and release of the Free-plan sign-up
Task.Notes: Migrate La Loy to the productized service, release the Free-plan sign-up and hand over to the support routine. Output: La Loy on the productized service, Release 2.1 in operation

Task.Name: M2 LCA: Lifecycle Architecture, SRS baseline
